index.description: Index identity: SOI, DMI (HadISST), DMI_CPC (ERSSTv6), or RONI.
index.null_semantics: Missing or not applicable source observation; never an imputed zero. See source-specific quality flags and coverage.
index.lineage: Preserved from enso_drivers_seasonal.parquet; transformations described by its maintained source builder.

season.description: Provider season label; for drivers DJF ends in the recorded year, NDJ starts in the preceding year. HarvestStat labels retain source meaning.
season.null_semantics: Missing or not applicable source observation; never an imputed zero. See source-specific quality flags and coverage.
season.lineage: Preserved from enso_drivers_seasonal.parquet; transformations described by its maintained source builder.

year.description: Calendar year; seasonal cross-year windows use the end-year convention in the source builder.
year.null_semantics: Missing or not applicable source observation; never an imputed zero. See source-specific quality flags and coverage.
year.lineage: Preserved from enso_drivers_seasonal.parquet; transformations described by its maintained source builder.

value.description: Observed index value: SOI is standardised; DMI, DMI_CPC and RONI are temperature differences/anomalies in degrees Celsius.
value.null_semantics: Missing or not applicable source observation; never an imputed zero. See source-specific quality flags and coverage.
value.lineage: Preserved from enso_drivers_seasonal.parquet; transformations described by its maintained source builder.

source.description: Originating provider or product, retained separately for each series.
source.null_semantics: Missing or not applicable source observation; never an imputed zero. See source-specific quality flags and coverage.
source.lineage: Preserved from enso_drivers_seasonal.parquet; transformations described by its maintained source builder.

source_lineage.source: NOAA CPC (RONI, SOI) + NOAA PSL (DMI/IOD, HadISST)
source_lineage.method: Self-fetching build (_sources/enso_drivers_build.py): parses the source ASCII; SOI/DMI seasonalised to 3-month overlapping seasons; RONI native seasonal. Spot-checked vs source. Rerun to refresh.

maintenance.rollback: Existing data are not modified by packaging; stage a new version and retain prior versions. Source refresh safeguards remain with each source builder.
